data.explanation: This is a closing electricity bill from your utility provider after you moved out of Lindenweg 12. It settles your remaining consumption and base fee for the first quarter of 2026. You need to pay the total amount of €105.58 to the provider's IBAN by the deadline shown (the app calculates it from the invoice date). If you don't pay in time, the provider may send a reminder or charge late fees, though none are mentioned here. No other action is required unless you dispute the consumption figures.
